raw_text:
UV is required for all Python operations. Never use `python -m`, `pip install`, or `python script.py` directly.
Commands:
uv run pytest
uv run pytest tests/pm_agent/
uv pip install package
uv run python script.py
make dev
make verify
make test
uv run pytest tests/pm_agent/ -v
uv run pytest tests/test_file.py -v
uv run pytest -m confidence_check
uv run pytest --cov=superclaude
make lint
make format
make doctor
make build-plugin
make sync-plugin-repo
make clean
